It is intended to serve the [[Visakhapatnam Metropolitan Region]] and is located off the [[National Highway 16 (India)|National Highway 16]], about {{cvt|45|km}} from [[Visakhapatnam]]. The airport was developed by GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Limited, a subsidiary of the [[GMR Group]]. It was named after the Indian revolutionary and freedom fighter [[Alluri Sitarama Raju]] in September 2024. The first phase of the project was constructed at a cost {{INRconvert|4592|c|lk=on}}.{{Cite news |last=Rao |first=V. |issn=0971-8257}} == History == === Background === North Andhra is currently served by [[Visakhapatnam Airport]], which operates as a civil enclave at [[INS Dega]], a [[naval air station]] of the [[Indian Navy]]. The airport is designated as a [[customs airport]] and handles only limited international flights.{{cite report |url=https://www.aai.aero/sites/default/files/airport_brochures/vizag%20brochure%20pdf_0.pdf |title=Visakhapatnam Airport |work=[[Airports Authority of India]] |access-date=1 June 2025 |archive-date=7 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240807190301/https://www.aai.aero/sites/default/files/airport_brochures/vizag%20brochure%20pdf_0.pdf |url-status=live }} The Indian Navy has said that it cannot allocate additional slots for commercial flights because of increased military use of the air station.{{cite news |title=No more flight slots at Vizag airport: Navy |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/96363453.cms |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=22 December 2022 |access-date=22 September 2024 |archive-date=4 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241204114612/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/96363453.cms |url-status=live }} A greenfield airport for Visakhapatnam was first proposed during the government of [[N. Chandrababu Naidu]] in 1997, when Andhra Pradesh was still undivided. Alternative sites including Sabbavaram, Achyutapuram and Koruprolu were also considered.{{cite journal |last1=Balarama Krishna |first1=R. V. |last2=Durga Rani |first2=K. |last3=Gopala Raju |first3=S. S. S. V. |year=2012 |title=Site suitability study for an International Airport in Visakhapatnam |url=https://www.i-scholar.in/index.php/ijeim/article/view/31707/27336 |journal=Indian Journal of Education and Information Management |volume=1 |issue=5 |pages=203–206 |issn=2277-5374 |via=i-Scholar }} === Planning and development === Following the [[Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014|state division]] in 2014, the newly elected TDP government, led by N. Chandrababu Naidu, proposed a 5,311 acre [[Aerotropolis]] at Bhogapuram.{{Cite web |last=Rao |first=G. Janardhana |date=2020-06-15 |title=‘Bhogapuram airport will spur growth in North Andhra’ |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/andhra-pradesh/2020/Jun/15/bhogapuram-airport-will-spur-growth-in-north-andhra-2156734.html |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}}{{Cite news |date=2015-03-12 |title=A.P. plans international airport near Vizag |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Visakhapatnam/ap-plans-international-airport-near-vizag/article6986702.ece |access-date=2026-07-30 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}{{Cite web |agency=PTI |date=2020-06-15 |title=Andhra govt drops Naidu's sprawling 'aerotropolis' airport plan in Vizag |url=https://www.thenewsminute.com/andhra-pradesh/andhra-govt-drops-naidus-sprawling-aerotropolis-airport-plan-vizag-126543 |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=The News Minute |language=en}} The YSRCP opposition, led by [[Y. S. Bhogapuram Airport Lands |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/andhra-pradesh/2015/Oct/06/jagan-again-flays-ap-over-bhogapuram-airport-lands-825401.html |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=The New soon led to various farmers protesting against the proposed airport.{{Cite news |date=2015-12-30 |title=Civil Aviation Ministry gives site clearance for Bhogapuram airport }} The project was scaled down to 2,703 acres. The airport was inaugurated on 1 August 2026, and the commercial operations are scheduled to begin on 17 August 2026.{{cite news |last=Rao |first=K. Srinivasa |date=20 July 2026 |title=After 43 years, a PM to visit Vizianagaram: Modi to inaugurate Bhogapuram airport on August 1 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/after-43-years-a-pm-to-visit-vizianagaram-modi-to-inaugurate-bhogapuram-airport-on-august-1/article71244313.ece |access-date=21 July 2026 |work=[[The Hindu]] |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X }}{{Cite web |date=2026-08-01 |title=PM Modi inaugurates Bhogapuram international airport, third for Andhra Pradesh |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/india/andhra-pradesh/story/bhogapuram-airport-inauguration-pm-modi-andhra-pradesh-projects-ptag-2961038-2026-08-01 |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=India Today |language=en}} === GMR Aerocity Bhogapuram === The GMR AeroCity is planned along side the airport with plans to develop commercial, hospitality, retail and business infrastructure.{{Cite news |date=2026-07-13 |title=Bay City to Aerocity: Govt approves VMRDA’s 2041 vision |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/vijayawada/bay-city-to-aerocity-govt-approves-vmrdas-2041-vision/articleshow/132372803.cms |access-date=2026-08-01 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} == Facilities == === Runway === {| class="wikitable" !Number !Length !Width ![[Instrument Landing System|ILS]] !Notes |- |10/28 |{{convert|3800|m|ft|abbr=on|sigfig=5}} |{{convert|45|m|ft|abbr=on}} |CAT I (RWY 28) |{{Cite web |date=29 April 2026 |title=Aerodrome Data, Bhogapuram International Airport (VOVI) |url=https://aim-india.aai.aero/sites/default/files/aip_supplements/AIPS_2026_80_0.pdf |url-status=live |access-date=30 July 2026 |website=aim-india.aai.aero}} |} The airport has a single Code 4E runway (10/28), measuring 3,800 metres (12,467 ft) in length and 45 metres (148 ft) in width, capable of handling wide-body aircraft. === Terminal === The modern integrated passenger terminal has an initial capacity to handle 6 million passengers per annum (MPPA) in its first phase, with scalability to 40 MPPA in future phases. Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport (IATA: VTZ (from 17 August 2026), ICAO: VOVI), also known as Bhogapuram Airport, is an international airport in Bhogapuram, Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh, India. It is intended to serve the Visakhapatnam Metropolitan Region and is located off the National Highway 16, about 45 km (28 mi) from Visakhapatnam. 
The airport was developed by GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Limited, a subsidiary of the GMR Group. It was named after the Indian revolutionary and freedom fighter Alluri Sitarama Raju in September 2024. The first phase of the project was constructed at a cost ₹4,592 crore (US$480 million).
The airport was inaugurated on 1 August 2026, while the commercial operations are scheduled to begin on 17 August 2026.
